capabilities: Draw freehand ink with stylus pressure
Draw shapes and arrows that attach to shapes
Present drawings with a laser pointer
Export drawings to PNG, SVG or PDF
Embed drawings in notes as SVG files
extras: Works entirely offline with no network requests; each drawing is a single self-contained SVG with no separate data file, and pasted images are stored inside it. An input diagnostics command shows latency numbers for troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in drawing tool, so sketches and diagrams have to be made in another app and imported as images.
summary: Drawing editor that saves sketches as plain SVG files embedded in notes, with shapes, arrows, stylus ink, a laser pointer and PNG/SVG/PDF export.
